title_ar: بيانُ مناصَرةٍ للمسجدِ الأقصَى من علماء وأئمة في موريتانيا
title_en: A Statement of Support for the Farthest Mosque (al-Masjid al-Aqṣā) from Scholars and Imams in Mauritania
body_ar:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
الحمد لله القائل في محكم كتابه: ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِ لَيْلًا مِّنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى الَّذِي بَارَكْنَا حَوْلَهُ لِنُرِيَهُ مِنْ آيَاتِنَا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ﴾..

وصلى الله وسلم على رسوله القائل: (لَا تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلَّا إلى ثَلَاثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ: مَسْجِدِي هذا، وَمَسْجِدِ الحَرَامِ، وَمَسْجِدِ الأقْصَى) متفقٌ عليه.

وبعد:
فقد تابعنا جميعا ما يقوم به قطعان الصهاينة المحتلين، من عساكر ومستوطنين، خلال شهر رمضان المبارك، من تدنيس للمسجد الأقصى، واعتداء على المصلين داخله، وإذلال للمعتكفين فيه، وإخراج للمتعبدين في رحابه، وسعي دائب في خرابه، وانتهاك مستمر لحرماته..
وأكثر المسلمين في مشارق الأرض ومغاربها يتابعون هذه المشاهد، وكأنها لا تعنيهم!!

والأدهى والأمَرُّ أن أكثر حكام المسلمين -وهم المخاطَبون قبل غيرهم بوجوب النصرة والجهاد والتصدي للعدو- إمَّا مُمالِئُون لأشد الناس عداوة للذين آمنوا، أو مطبّعون معهم، أو ﴿يُسَارِعُونَ فِيهِمْ يَقُولُونَ نَخْشَىٰ أَن تُصِيبَنَا دَائِرَةٌ﴾ إلا من رحم ربك من هؤلاء الحكام، وقليلٌ مَّا هُم!!

أما المجتمع الدولي الذي يتحدث عن حقوق الإنسان، وحرية العبادة، واحترام المقدسات، وحق تقرير المصير، والمواثيق الدولية، وما تفرضه على الغاصب المحتل تجاه المناطق المحتلة، فهو متمالئٌ متواطئ، وإن أظهر القلق، فهو قلق سببه ما قد تجر إليه جرائم الاحتلال من إحياء لروح الجهاد، والثأر والاستشهاد..

إننا -نحن الموقعين اسفله من علماء موريتانيا وأئمتها ودعاتها وشيوخ محاضرها - في هذا الظرف العصيب الذي يمر به المسجد الأقصى خاصة، وفلسطين عامة نؤكد على ما يلي:

أولا : أن شأن المسجد الأقصى المبارك شأنُ عقيدة ودينٍ بالنسبة لهذه الأمة، فهو أحد مساجدها المقدسة، وفضله مسطور في كتاب ربها، مَزبُورٌ في سنة نبيها، وتاريخِ سلفِها.

والصراعُ مع أعداء الأمة حوْلَه ليس مجرد صراعِ سياسة أو حدود، بل هو صراع عقيدة ووجود.

ثانيا : أن الطريق إلى تحرير الأقصى خاصة، وفلسطين عامة، يمر حتما بعودة الأمة الشاملة الكاملة لكتاب ربها، وسنة نبيها صلى الله عليه وسلم، عقيدةً، وشريعةً، وسلوكًا، وسياسةً، ومنهجَ حياة كاملَا.
{إن تنصروا الله ينصركم}

ثالثا : أن الجهاد في سبيل الله تعالى هو الطريق الوحيد لتحرير الأقصى وفلسطينَ، وهو فريضةٌ شرعية، وضرورة واقعية.
وكل الحلول الأخرى حلول عبثية، تضفي على الاحتلال الشرعية، وتجعل من كيانه حقيقة واقعية.
وتستوى في ذلك قرارات التقسيم الأممية، واتفاقيات السلام و(التطبيع) الثنائية، والإقليمية، فكلها باطلة شرعا، مرفوضة عقلا، فاشلة واقعا.

رابعا : أن الجهاد لتحرير الأقصى وفلسطين، فرض على الأمة كلها، كلٌّ بحسب قدرته، وموقعه.
وهو جهادُ دفعٍ، وجهادُ الدفعِ هو آكَدُ حالات الجهاد وجوبا.
والجهاد هنا جهاد بكل صور وأنواع الجهاد.. جهاد بالنفس، والمال، واللسان، والسِّنان.
(جاهدوا المشركين بأموالكم، وأنفسكم، وألسنتكم) رواه أبو داود، وأحمد ، وهو صحيح.
وتتأكد بعض أنواع هذا الجهاد في حق بعض فئات الأمة أكثر من غيرها.

فواجب أهل فلسطين والأقصى الأولُ هو الجهاد بالنفس والمال، والمصابرة، والمرابطة، فهم رأس الحربة، وطليعة الأمة في هذا الصراع: ﴿وَقَاتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ الله الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ وَلَا تَعْتَدُوا ۚ إِنَّ الله لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ﴾.
﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ﴾.

والواجب الأول على علماء الأمة وأئمتِها بيانُ الحق والصدعُ به، وتذكيرُ المسلمين بالواجب تجاه إخوانهم من النصرة والدعم، وتحريض الأمة على الجهاد في سبيل الله بمختلف صوره، وإحياء هذه المعاني التي يُعِزّ الله بها الأمة، ويذل بها العدو: ﴿ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى الْقِتَالِ﴾.
وواجب الحكام هو المناصرة والمؤازرة بشتى صورها، ومختلف أشكالها..السياسية، والعسكرية، والمادية والمعنوية: ﴿وَإِنِ اسْتَنصَرُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ فَعَلَيْكُمُ النَّصْرُ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَاقٌ﴾.

ويجب عليهم الحذر من تولِي هؤلاء الأعداء، و(التطبيعِ) معهم، والسيرِ في رِكابِهم، فإن الله عز وجل يقول: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ أَوْلِيَاءَ ۘ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ الله لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾.

وواجب حملة الأقلام، ورجال الإعلام، وأصحاب المنابر، وأرباب المحابر، توعيةُ الأمة، وربطُها بقضية مقدساتها، وكشف خطط الأعداء، وفضح سياساتهم، وكشف المتمالئين معهم من المنافقين، والمطبعين، وهذا من الجهاد باللسان.

وواجب التجار ورجال الأعمال الأول هو الجهاد بالمال، فالجهاد بالمال مقدم على الجهاد بالنفس في أكثر آيات الجهاد.
وهو كذلك في السنة.

﴿إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالله وَرَسُولِهِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا وَجَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ الله أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الصَّادِقُونَ﴾.
وفي الصحيحين: (مَن جَهَّزَ غازِيًا في سَبيلِ اللهِ، فقَدْ غَزَا، ومَن خَلَفَهُ في أهْلِهِ بخَيْرٍ، فقَدْ غَزَا).

وواجب الآباء والأمهات غرس محبة الأقصى وفلسطين في قلوب الأولاد، وتربيتهم على حب الجهاد والاستشهاد من أجل تحريرهما، فقد قال صلى الله عليه وسلم عن المسجد الأقصى: (ولَنِعْمَ المصلَّى، هوَ أرضُ المَحشرِ والمنشَرِ، وليأتيَنَّ على النَّاسِ زمانٌ ولَقِيدُ سَوطِ -أو قال: قوسِ- الرَّجلِ حَيثُ يرى مِنهُ بيتَ المقدسِ؛ خيرٌ لهُ أو أحبُّ إليه مِنَ الدُّنيا جميعًا) رواه البيهقي والطبراني والحاكم.

وصححه الألباني.
وواجب الشعوب الإسلامية المناصرةُ والمؤازرة، والدعم بمختلف صوره، واستنكارُ جرائم المحتلين بكل الوسائل الممكنة، والمتاحة: (المُسْلِمُ أخُو المُسْلِمِ، لا يَظْلِمُهُ ولا يُسْلِمُهُ، ومَن كانَ في حاجَةِ أخِيهِ كانَ اللَّهُ في حاجَتِهِ) متفق عليه.

خامسا : أن النصر على اليهود الغزاة قادم حتما بإخبار الصادق المصدوق صلى الله عليه وسلم: (لا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حتَّى يُقاتِلَ المُسْلِمُونَ اليَهُود، فَيَقْتُلُهُمُ المُسْلِمُونَ حتَّى يَخْتَبِئَ اليَهُودِيُّ مِن وراءِ الحَجَرِ والشَّجَرِ، فيَقولُ الحَجَرُ أوِ الشَّجَرُ: يا مُسْلِمُ يا عَبْدَ اللهِ هذا يَهُودِيٌّ خَلْفِي، فَتَعالَ فاقْتُلْهُ، إلَّا الغَرْقَدَ، فإنَّه مِن شَجَرِ اليَهُود) رواه مسلم.

ولكن ذلك النصر لا بد له من أسباب ومقومات، يجمعُها نصرُنا لله.. عودةً لدينه، وتحكيمًا لشريعته، وتمسكًا بكتابه، وعضًّا بالنواجذ على سنة رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِن تَنصُرُوا اللهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ﴾.
اللهم انصر المجاهدين في سبيلك، والعاملين لدينك..
اللهم سدد رأيهم، ورميهم، وانصرهم على عدوك وعدوهم.
اللهم كن لهم وليا ونصيرا، ومُعينا وظهيرا.
وصلِّ اللهمَّ وسلم على نبينا محمد وعلى آله وصحبه أجمعين..

body_en:
In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Mercy-Giving
Praise belongs to God, who said in the clear text of His Book: {Glory be to Him who carried His servant by night from the Sacred Mosque to the Farthest Mosque, whose surroundings We have blessed, that We might show him something of Our signs. He indeed is the Hearing, the Seeing} (Sūrat al-Isrāʾ 17:1)..

And may God bless and grant peace to His Messenger, who said: (Mounts are not to be saddled except towards three mosques: this mosque of mine, the Sacred Mosque, and the Farthest Mosque) — agreed upon.

To proceed:
We have all followed what the herds of the occupying Zionists, soldiers and settlers alike, have been doing during the blessed month of Ramadan: the defiling of the Farthest Mosque, the assault upon those praying inside it, the humiliation of those in spiritual retreat within it, the driving out of those worshipping in its precincts, the unremitting striving for its ruin, and the continual violation of its sanctities..
And most of the Muslims in the east and the west of the earth follow these scenes as though they did not concern them!!

And what is more grievous and more bitter is that most of the rulers of the Muslims — who are addressed before anyone else by the obligation of coming to its aid, of jihad and of standing up to the enemy — are either colluding with the most hostile of people towards those who believe, or normalising with them, or else they {hasten towards them, saying: we fear that a turn of fortune may strike us} (Sūrat al-Māʾidah 5:52) — except such of these rulers as your Lord has had mercy upon, and how few they are!!

As for the international community, which speaks of human rights, of freedom of worship, of respect for sanctities, of the right of self-determination, of the international covenants and of what they impose upon a usurping occupier towards occupied territories — it is colluding and complicit; and if it shows concern, it is a concern caused by what the occupation's crimes may draw on of a reviving of the spirit of jihad, of vengeance and of seeking martyrdom..

We — the undersigned below, from among the scholars of Mauritania, its imams, its callers to Islam and the sheikhs of its mahdaras — in this grave situation through which the Farthest Mosque in particular, and Palestine in general, are passing, affirm the following:

First: that the matter of the blessed Farthest Mosque is a matter of creed and of religion for this Ummah. It is one of its sanctified mosques; its merit is inscribed in the Book of its Lord, written down in the sunnah of its Prophet and in the history of its predecessors.

And the struggle with the enemies of the Ummah over it is not a mere struggle of politics or of borders; rather it is a struggle of creed and of existence.

Second: that the road to the liberation of the Farthest Mosque in particular, and of Palestine in general, passes of necessity through the Ummah's complete and total return to the Book of its Lord and the sunnah of its Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace — in creed, in law, in conduct, in politics, and as an entire way of life.
{If you aid God, He will aid you} (Sūrat Muḥammad 47:7)

Third: that jihad in the path of God Almighty is the only road to the liberation of the Farthest Mosque and of Palestine, and it is an obligation in the Sharia (farīḍah sharʿiyyah) and a necessity in fact.
All other solutions are futile solutions, which confer legitimacy upon the occupation and make of its entity a reality in fact.
In this the partition resolutions of the United Nations and the peace and (normalisation) agreements, bilateral and regional, are all alike: all of them are void in the Sharia, rejected by reason, and failures in fact.

Fourth: that jihad for the liberation of the Farthest Mosque and of Palestine is an obligation upon the whole Ummah, each according to his capacity and his position.
And it is a jihad of repulsion, and the jihad of repulsion is the most emphatic of the states of jihad in its obligatoriness.
And jihad here is jihad in every form and kind of jihad.. jihad with one's self, with wealth, with the tongue, and with the spearhead.
(Wage jihad against the associators with your wealth, your selves and your tongues) — narrated by Abu Dawud and Ahmad, and it is sound.
And some kinds of this jihad are more emphatic in respect of some categories of the Ummah than of others.

So the foremost duty of the people of Palestine and of the Farthest Mosque is jihad with the self and with wealth, and perseverance, and holding the frontier; for they are the spearhead and the vanguard of the Ummah in this struggle: {And fight in the path of God those who fight you, and do not transgress; God does not love the transgressors} (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:190).
{O you who believe, be patient, and vie in patience, and hold the frontier, and be conscious of God, that you may prosper} (Sūrat Āl ʿImrān 3:200).

And the foremost duty upon the scholars of the Ummah and its imams is to set out the truth and to proclaim it openly; to remind the Muslims of the duty towards their brethren of coming to their aid and supporting them; to urge the Ummah on to jihad in the path of God in its various forms; and to revive these meanings by which God gives the Ummah might and by which He abases the enemy: {O Prophet, urge the believers on to fighting} (Sūrat al-Anfāl 8:65).
And the duty of the rulers is aid and support in all its forms and its various shapes.. political, military, material and moral: {And if they seek your aid in religion, then aid is incumbent upon you, except against a people between whom and you there is a treaty} (Sūrat al-Anfāl 8:72).

And it is obligatory upon them to beware of taking these enemies as allies, of (normalisation) with them, and of walking in their train; for God, mighty and majestic, says: {O you who believe, do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies; they are allies of one another. Whoever among you takes them as allies is one of them. God does not guide the wrongdoing people} (Sūrat al-Māʾidah 5:51).

And the duty of those who carry pens, of the men of the media, of the holders of pulpits and of the masters of inkwells is to make the Ummah aware, to bind it to the cause of its sanctities, to uncover the plans of the enemies and expose their policies, and to expose those colluding with them among the hypocrites and the normalisers — and this is part of jihad with the tongue.

And the foremost duty of the traders and the businessmen is jihad with wealth; for jihad with wealth is placed before jihad with the self in most of the verses on jihad.
And it is likewise in the sunnah.

{The believers are only those who have believed in God and His Messenger, then have not doubted, and have waged jihad with their wealth and their selves in the path of God — those are the truthful ones} (Sūrat al-Ḥujurāt 49:15).
And in the two Ṣaḥīḥs: (Whoever equips a fighter in the path of God has himself fought, and whoever looks after his family well in his absence has himself fought).

And the duty of fathers and mothers is to plant love of the Farthest Mosque and of Palestine in the hearts of their children, and to bring them up upon love of jihad and of martyrdom for the sake of liberating the two of them; for he said, God bless him and grant him peace, of the Farthest Mosque: (And what an excellent place of prayer it is. It is the land of the Gathering and the Resurrection. There will come upon people a time when the length of a man's whip — or he said: of his bow — in a place from which he can see Jerusalem will be better for him, or dearer to him, than the whole world) — narrated by al-Bayhaqi, al-Tabarani and al-Hakim.

And al-Albani graded it sound.
And the duty of the Islamic peoples is aid and support, and backing in its various forms, and denouncing the crimes of the occupiers by every possible and available means: (The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim; he does not wrong him and does not hand him over; and whoever is engaged in his brother's need, God is engaged in his) — agreed upon.

Fifth: that victory over the invading Jews is certainly coming, by the informing of the truthful and trusted one, God bless him and grant him peace: (The Hour will not come until the Muslims fight the Jews, and the Muslims kill them, until the Jew hides behind the rock and the tree, and the rock or the tree says: Muslim, servant of God, this is a Jew behind me — come and kill him; except the boxthorn, for it is one of the trees of the Jews) — narrated by Muslim.

But that victory must have its causes and its foundations, which our aiding of God gathers together.. a return to His religion, a ruling by His law, a holding fast to His Book, and a biting down with the molars upon the sunnah of His Messenger, God bless him and grant him peace: {O you who believe, if you aid God, He will aid you and make your feet firm} (Sūrat Muḥammad 47:7).
O God, aid those who wage jihad in Your path and those who work for Your religion..
O God, make right their judgement and their aim, and aid them against Your enemy and theirs.
O God, be for them a protector and a helper, a supporter and a backer.
And bless, O God, and grant peace to our Prophet Muhammad and to his family and all his Companions..
Nouakchott, dated: 19 Ramadan 1444 of the Hijrah
Corresponding to: 10 April 2023

flags.context: the third of the five points, on jihad as the road to liberation
options: it is an obligation in the Sharia (farīḍah sharʿiyyah) and a necessity in fact
it is a religious duty and a practical necessity
it is legally obligatory and realistically necessary
flags.note: farīḍah is from the same root as farḍ, which the glossary fixes as 'obligatory'. The rendering must not be weakened to 'duty' nor strengthened; option 1 blurs the technical force and option 2 reads ḍarūrah as ordinary practicality, whereas the glossary marks ḍarūrah as a technical threshold distinct from mere hardship. Note that the statement does not here specify what acts fall under jihad; it specifies them lower down, where the categories named for most readers are the tongue and wealth.

flags.arabic: وهو جهاد دفع، وجهاد الدفع هو آكد حالات الجهاد وجوبا
options: it is a jihad of repulsion, and the jihad of repulsion is the most emphatic of the states of jihad in its obligatoriness
it is defensive jihad, and defensive jihad is the most strongly obligatory kind
this is a jihad of defence, which is the most binding form of jihad
flags.note: jihād al-dafʿ is the technical category of repelling an aggressor who has entered Muslim territory, as against jihād al-ṭalab. 'Defensive jihad' is the usual English and is readily understood, but it is a looser term and in English carries a justificatory colouring the Arabic technical term does not. The literal rendering has been kept and the alternative recorded.

flags.arabic: فكلها باطلة شرعا، مرفوضة عقلا، فاشلة واقعا
flags.context: the statement's verdict on partition resolutions and peace and normalisation agreements
options: all of them are void in the Sharia, rejected by reason, and failures in fact
all are invalid religiously, unacceptable rationally, and unsuccessful practically
they are all null in law, irrational and ineffective
flags.note: bāṭil is the glossary's 'void'. Applied here to treaties and resolutions it is close to the glossary's own sense, which concerns the legal effect of an instrument rather than its sinfulness, so 'void' stands. The three-part rhymed cadence of the Arabic cannot be reproduced and has not been forced.

flags.context: the duty stated of fathers and mothers
options: to bring them up upon love of jihad and of martyrdom
to raise them to love struggle and self-sacrifice
to educate them in the love of jihad and of seeking martyrdom
flags.note: istishhād is seeking martyrdom, which in this register means being killed in the cause, not suicide operations specifically, and the statement does not mention any particular method. Option 1 would soften jihād to 'struggle' and istishhād to 'self-sacrifice', which the style guide forbids; option 2's 'educate' is weaker than tarbiyah. The sentence has been translated as it stands. It is a principal reason this record is marked for editorial review.

flags.arabic: لا تقوم الساعة حتى يقاتل المسلمون اليهود
flags.context: the hadith quoted under the fifth point
options: translate in full with the attribution the statement gives
translate with an added note on how the hadith is read
flags.note: This is the hadith of the rock and the tree, narrated by Muslim, which the statement quotes to assert that victory is certain. The translator's duty is to render it and its attribution exactly, and no gloss, mitigation or context has been added, since the signatories add none. It is quoted here of the present conflict. This is recorded as a flag, not as a translation difficulty, because it is the single passage in the corpus most likely to be extracted and read on its own.

options: the sheikhs of its traditional colleges
the heads of its religious schools
flags.note: maḥḍarah (plural maḥāḍir) is the Mauritanian nomadic teaching circle, and the style guide's own preface names the mahdara tradition, so the term is already in the project's vocabulary. 'College' and 'school' both suggest a building and a curriculum the institution does not have.

translator_notes: This record is not a text by Sheikh al-Dedew alone. It is a collective statement issued by scholars, imams, callers and mahdara sheikhs of Mauritania, which he signs first among some one hundred and fifteen signatories. The site must not display it as his fatwa or as his own composition; the first person throughout is 'we, the undersigned'.

Qur'anic quotations are rendered in curly quotation marks with references per style guide section 4, and the source's ornate Qur'anic brackets and stop marks are preserved in body_ar. One quotation, {If you aid God, He will aid you}, appears in the source in ordinary braces rather than ornate ones and without vowelling; that difference is preserved. Qur'anic renderings in this corpus are interpretive and not a substitute for the Arabic.

Hadith attributions are given exactly as the signatories give them: 'agreed upon' twice, 'narrated by Abu Dawud and Ahmad, and it is sound', 'in the two Ṣaḥīḥs', 'narrated by al-Bayhaqi, al-Tabarani and al-Hakim' with 'al-Albani graded it sound', and 'narrated by Muslim'. No grading has been added and none dropped.

المسجد الأقصى is rendered 'the Farthest Mosque' with the Arabic bracketed at the title, since the English name is what the Qur'anic verse quoted in the first line calls it; 'al-Aqsa Mosque' would be the more familiar form and the site may prefer it.
التطبيع appears twice in the source inside parentheses, which is the signatories' own way of holding the word at arm's length; the parentheses are preserved in both languages.
اسفله in 'the undersigned below' is written without its hamza in the source and is preserved as served.

The romanisation of the signatories' names is provisional. Mauritanian names have established French-based spellings that differ from the corpus's Arabic-based romanisation, and several entries here are colloquial forms. The Sheikh's office should check the list before publication.

Two signatory entries carry stray vowel marks in the source (أمين with a damma; امَّوْ), preserved in body_ar. One entry uses the Persian letter چ, which is used in Mauritanian Arabic for a sound standard Arabic lacks; preserved.
editorial_review_reasons: This is the most editorially exposed record in this batch. It declares that jihad is the only road to the liberation of al-Aqsa and Palestine and an obligation in the Sharia upon the whole Ummah; it declares partition resolutions and all peace and normalisation agreements void; it states as a duty of parents that they bring their children up upon love of jihad and of martyrdom; and it supplicates for the victory of those waging jihad. Published in English under Ummah Collective's name, material of this kind engages counter-terrorism, incitement and broadcasting law in the United Kingdom, the European Union, the United States, Australia and elsewhere, quite apart from the reputational exposure.

The statement quotes the hadith of the rock and the tree — that the Hour will not come until the Muslims fight the Jews and kill them — and applies it to the present conflict without gloss. Extracted and read alone, in English, this passage is the one most likely to be presented as evidence of incitement against Jews as such.
It quotes Qur'an 5:51 on not taking Jews and Christians as allies, in a political context and without the interpretive qualifications the exegetical tradition attaches to it.
It describes the rulers of Muslim states as colluding with the enemy, and the signatories are named, which raises questions of exposure for them as well as for the publisher.

Everything has been translated faithfully and nothing has been softened, strengthened, omitted or glossed away, as style guide section 12 requires. The decision whether and how to publish this record, and whether to publish the signatory list at all, belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office, and should not be taken by default.

If the record is published, the site should make unmistakable that this is a collective statement of more than a hundred signatories and not a fatwa of Sheikh al-Dedew, who is one signatory among them.
